Method of Attack: Compromise business networks by targeting business network and employee personal accounts that share access with business networks or devices
Exploitation of insecure Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) or Virtual Private Networks
Privilege escalation and lateral network movement
Data exfiltration camouflaged as a Service Host Process (svchost) process

Exfiltration tools camouflaged as svchost process
